title: 上部 凡尘问道 第5章 道院噬灵局零根破阵斩奸上部 凡尘问道 第6章 杂役营霸凌与立威

第1节灵根检测，零根遭驱逐
三千道院外门入口，青灰色的石墙高耸入云，门口两侧的鎏金柱子上刻着“道贯天地，法统古今”八个大字，透着一股威严肃穆。
凌无妄四人刚走到门口，就被两名身着灰袍的守门弟子拦下。左边的弟子名叫赵磊，眼神倨傲，上下打量着四人，见他们衣着破旧，身上还带着风雪的痕迹，眼中闪过一丝鄙夷“站住！你们是什么人？来道院做什么？”
“弟子凌无妄，带着家人和朋友前来投奔，想应聘杂役，求大人通融。”凌无妄上前一步，恭敬地说道。
“应聘杂役？”赵磊嗤笑一声，“三千道院可不是阿猫阿狗都能进的地方！凡入道院者，无论弟子还是杂役，都需通过灵根检测，至少要有伪灵根才能留下，否则连灵气都感应不到，怎么干活？”
凌无妄心中一沉，他知道自己是无灵根，这是最大的硬伤。“大人，我们只求一份糊口的活计，不一定需要感应灵气，砍柴挑水、打扫卫生我们都能做。”
“少废话！”右边的弟子孙浩不耐烦地挥手，“道院规矩，没有灵根者一律不准入内！赶紧走，别在这里耽误我们做事！”
凌母急忙上前求情“两位大人，求求你们通融一下，我们实在走投无路了，要是被后面的仇家追上，就只有死路一条了！”
“仇家？”赵磊眼神一凝，上下打量着四人，似乎察觉到了什么，“你们得罪了什么人？如实招来，否则别怪我们不客气！”
凌无妄心中咯噔一下，他知道不能暴露被天道钱庄追杀的事情，否则不仅进不了道院，还会引来更大的麻烦。“只是一些乡野恶霸，算不上什么大人物，还请大人不要多问。”
“乡野恶霸？我看不像！”孙浩冷笑一声，伸手就要推搡凌无妄，“我看你们形迹可疑，说不定是奸细，给我滚开！”
就在这时，系统面板突然弹出提示【警告！检测到天道钱庄清除者气息，距离15里，预计抵达时间15分钟！】
凌无妄心中一惊，清除者来得这么快，必须尽快进入道院，否则就真的完蛋了。“两位大人，我们真的没有恶意，只求能进入道院避难，还请通融！”
“通融？除非太阳打西边出来！”赵磊态度坚决，“没有灵根，就算天王老子来了也没用，赶紧走，否则我们就动手了！”
他抬手运转灵力，炼气中期的威压释放出来，朝着凌无妄四人压去。凌母和凌小雨脸色发白，忍不住后退了一步。
苏晚晴立刻上前一步，运转炼气巅峰的灵力，挡住了赵磊的威压“两位大人，凡事留一线，日后好相见。我们只是想应聘杂役，没必要赶尽杀绝吧？”
赵磊和孙浩没想到苏晚晴竟然有炼气巅峰的修为，脸色微微一变，但很快又恢复了倨傲“就算你有炼气巅峰又如何？没有灵根，一样不能进！再说，你一个炼气巅峰，不去应聘外门弟子，反而跟着几个凡人来应聘杂役，本身就可疑！”
凌无妄知道，再这样僵持下去，等清除者赶到，就彻底没机会了。他运转规则之眼，朝着灵根检测阵望去，想要找到破解之法。
很快，他就看穿了检测阵的规则——这是一个基于灵气感应的基础阵法，阵法核心会释放出微弱的灵气，感应应聘者体内的灵根资质，只要感应到的灵气波动达到最低阈值，就会判定为伪灵根，允许进入。
而这个最低阈值，存在一个规则漏洞——阵法只检测灵气波动的强度，不检测灵气的来源，也就是说，只要能从外部引入一丝微弱的灵气，让其在体内短暂停留，就能蒙混过关。

“有办法了！”凌无妄心中一动，朝着苏晚晴使了个眼色。
第2节漏洞破阵，借力蒙过关
苏晚晴立刻明白了凌无妄的意思，悄悄运转灵力，准备随时输送一丝灵气给凌无妄。
“两位大人，既然你们这么看重灵根检测，那我愿意试一试。”凌无妄上前一步，说道，“如果我能通过检测，还请你们允许我们进入道院。”
“你？一个凡人还想通过灵根检测？”赵磊像是听到了天大的笑话，“我告诉你，无灵根就是无灵根，就算你再怎么挣扎也没用，只会自取其辱！”
“行不行，试过才知道。”凌无妄语气坚定，走到灵根检测阵前。
检测阵是一个圆形的石台，上面刻满了复杂的符文，中间镶嵌着一颗乳白色的晶石，正是检测阵的核心。
赵磊冷笑一声，启动了检测阵“好，我就成全你！等你检测失败，看你还有什么话说！”
符文亮起淡淡的白光，乳白色的晶石释放出微弱的灵气，笼罩住凌无妄。赵磊和孙浩抱着胳膊，等着看凌无妄出丑。
凌无妄深吸一口气，集中精神，朝着苏晚晴示意。苏晚晴立刻运转灵力，一丝微弱到几乎无法察觉的灵气，顺着地面的缝隙，悄无声息地涌入凌无妄体内。
凌无妄将这丝灵气控制在丹田附近，不让其扩散。在规则之眼的辅助下，他能清晰地感觉到，检测阵的灵气正在感应他体内的灵气波动。
“还差一点！”凌无妄心中暗道，让苏晚晴再输送一丝灵气。
苏晚晴毫不犹豫，又输送了一丝灵气。这一次，灵气波动刚好达到了检测阵的最低阈值。
“嗡！”
检测阵中间的乳白色晶石突然亮起一道微弱的绿光，上面显示出“伪灵根”三个字。
“什么？！”赵磊和孙浩脸色大变，不敢相信自己的眼睛，“这怎么可能？他明明是个凡人，怎么会有伪灵根？”
凌无妄心中松了一口气，脸上却不动声色“两位大人，现在可以让我们进去了吧？”
赵磊和孙浩面面相觑，眼中满是疑惑和不甘。他们刚才明明感觉到凌无妄身上没有任何灵气波动，怎么会突然检测出伪灵根？
“一定是检测阵出问题了！”孙浩不死心，上前检查了一下检测阵，却发现阵法运转正常，没有任何故障。
“不可能！绝对不可能！”赵磊还是不愿意相信，“你肯定是耍了什么花招！”

“两位大人，检测阵就在这里，是不是耍花招，你们一目了然。”凌无妄说道，“道院规矩，通过灵根检测者即可应聘杂役，还请你们遵守规矩。”
就在这时，远处传来一阵急促的脚步声，一名弟子气喘吁吁地跑过来“赵哥，孙哥，快点！监工王坤大人来了，要是让他看到你们在这里磨蹭，肯定要生气的！”
赵磊和孙浩脸色一变，王坤是外门杂役营的监工，炼气后期修为，为人刻薄，得罪他可没好果子吃。

Section 1 Spiritual Root Testing, Linggen was expelled
At the entrance to the outer gate of Sanqian Taoist Temple, the blue-grey stone wall towers into the clouds. The gilt pillars on both sides of the door are engraved with the eight characters "The Tao runs through the heaven and the earth, and the Dharma rules the past and the present", which exudes a sense of majesty and solemnity.
As soon as Ling Wuwang and the other two reached the door, they were stopped by two gatekeeper disciples in gray robes. The disciple on the left is named Zhao Lei, with arrogant eyes. He looked the four of them up and down. Seeing that their clothes were shabby and there were traces of wind and snow on their bodies, a trace of contempt flashed in his eyes: "Stop! Who are you? What are you doing in the Taoist Temple?"
"Disciple Ling Wuwang came here with his family and friends. He wants to apply for a job as a handyman. Please forgive me." Ling Wuwang took a step forward and said respectfully.
"Applying for a job as a handyman?" Zhao Lei sneered, "Three Thousand Taoist Temple is not a place where even cats and dogs can enter! Anyone who enters the Taoist Temple, whether a disciple or a handyman, must pass the spiritual root test. They must have at least pseudo spiritual roots to stay. Otherwise, they cannot even sense spiritual energy, so how can they work?"
Ling Wuwang's heart sank. He knew that he had no spiritual roots, which was his biggest flaw. "Sir, we just want a job to make a living. We don't necessarily need to sense spiritual energy. We can chop wood, carry water, and clean."
"Stop talking nonsense!" Sun Hao, the disciple on the right, waved his hand impatiently, "The rules of the Taoist academy are that no one without spiritual roots is allowed to enter! Leave quickly, don't delay our work here!"
Ling's mother hurriedly stepped forward to plead, "Two adults, please be accommodating. We are really desperate. If we are caught up by the enemies behind us, we will be dead!"
"Enemies?" Zhao Lei's eyes narrowed and he looked at the four people up and down, as if he noticed something, "Who have you offended? Tell them truthfully, otherwise don't blame us for being rude!"
Ling Wuwang's heart skipped a beat. He knew he couldn't expose the fact that he was being chased by Tiandao Bank. Otherwise, not only would he not be able to enter the Taoist temple, but he would also cause even greater trouble. "They are just some country bullies, not big shots. Please don't ask any more questions."
"Country bullies? I don't think so!" Sun Hao sneered, reaching out to push Ling Wuwang, "I think you are acting suspiciously, maybe you are spies, get out of here!"
At this moment, the system panel suddenly popped up a prompt [Warning! The aura of the Tiandao Bank Cleaner has been detected, the distance is 15 miles, and the estimated arrival time is 15 minutes! 】
Ling Wuwang was shocked. The purgers came so quickly. He had to enter the Taoist temple as soon as possible, otherwise he would really be doomed. "Two adults, we really don't have any ill intentions. We just want to be able to enter the Taoist temple for refuge. Please be lenient!"
"Be accommodating? Unless the sun comes out in the west!" Zhao Lei said firmly, "Without spiritual roots, it will be useless even if the King of Heaven comes. Leave quickly, otherwise we will take action!"
He raised his hand to circulate his spiritual power, and the pressure from the middle stage of Qi refining was released, pressing towards Ling Wuwang and the four others. Mother Ling and Ling Xiaoyu turned pale and couldn't help but take a step back.
Su Wanqing immediately took a step forward, using her spiritual power at the peak of Qi refining to block Zhao Lei's pressure. "Two adults, please keep a line in everything so that we can meet each other in the future. We just want to apply for a job as a handyman, there is no need to kill everyone, right?"
Zhao Lei and Sun Hao didn't expect that Su Wanqing had the cultivation level of the peak Qi Refining Peak. Their expressions changed slightly, but they soon returned to their arrogance. "So what if you are at the peak Qi Refining Peak? Without spiritual roots, you still can't get in! Besides, it's suspicious that you, a peak Qi Refining Master, don't apply for an outer disciple, but follow a few mortals to apply for a handyman job!"
Ling Wuwang knew that if the stalemate continued like this, there would be no chance at all when the purgers arrived. He ran his eyes of rules and looked towards the spiritual root detection array, trying to find a way to crack it.
Soon, he saw through the rules of the detection array - this is a basic array based on spiritual energy induction. The core of the array will release weak spiritual energy to sense the spiritual root qualifications in the applicant's body. As long as the sensed spiritual energy fluctuation reaches the minimum threshold, it will be judged.It is designated as a false spiritual root and is allowed to enter.
There is a loophole in this minimum threshold - the formation only detects the intensity of the spiritual energy fluctuations, not the source of the spiritual energy. In other words, as long as a weak spiritual energy can be introduced from the outside and allowed to stay in the body for a short time, it can get away with it.
"We have a solution!" Ling Wuwang's heart moved and he winked at Su Wanqing.
In the second quarter, loopholes break the formation and use the strength to get through.
Su Wanqing immediately understood what Ling Wuwang meant, and quietly circulated her spiritual power, ready to send a trace of spiritual energy to Ling Wuwang at any time.
"Two adults, since you value the spiritual root test so much, I am willing to give it a try." Ling Wuwu stepped forward and said, "If I can pass the test, please allow us to enter the Taoist Academy."
"You? A mortal still wants to pass the spiritual root test?" Zhao Lei seemed to have heard a big joke, "I tell you, no spiritual root means no spiritual root. No matter how hard you struggle, it will be useless, you will only humiliate yourself!"
"Whether it works or not, you won't know until you try it." Ling Wuwang said firmly and walked to the spiritual root detection array.
The detection array is a circular stone platform, engraved with complex runes, with a milky white crystal inlaid in the middle, which is the core of the detection array.
Zhao Lei sneered and activated the detection array, "Okay, I'll help you! Wait until you fail the test and see what else you have to say!"
The runes lit up with a faint white light, and the milky white crystal released a weak aura, covering Ling Wuwang. Zhao Lei and Sun Hao crossed their arms, waiting to see Ling Wuwu make a fool of himself.
Ling Wuwang took a deep breath, concentrated his attention, and motioned towards Su Wanqing. Su Wanqing immediately activated her spiritual energy, and a trace of spiritual energy that was so weak that it was almost imperceptible flowed into Ling Wuwang's body silently along the cracks in the ground.
Ling Wuwang controlled this spiritual energy near his dantian to prevent it from spreading. With the help of the Eye of Rules, he could clearly feel that the aura of the detection array was sensing the aura fluctuations in his body.
"Not even close!" Ling Wuwang thought to himself, asking Su Wanqing to send another trace of spiritual energy.
Su Wanqing did not hesitate and sent another trace of spiritual energy. This time, the spiritual energy fluctuations just reached the minimum threshold of the detection array.
"Buzz!"
The milky white crystal in the middle of the detection array suddenly lit up with a weak green light, and the words "pseudo spiritual root" were displayed on it.
"What?!" Zhao Lei and Sun Hao's expressions changed greatly. They couldn't believe their eyes. "How is this possible? He is obviously a mortal, how can he have false spiritual roots?"
Ling Wuwang breathed a sigh of relief, but his face remained calm: "Two adults, can you let us in now?"
Zhao Lei and Sun Hao looked at each other with confusion and unwillingness in their eyes. They clearly felt that Ling Wuwang didn't have any spiritual energy fluctuations just now, so how could they suddenly detect false spiritual roots?
"There must be something wrong with the detection array!" Sun Hao refused to give up and stepped forward to check the detection array, only to find that the array was operating normally without any malfunction.
"Impossible! Absolutely impossible!" Zhao Lei still didn't want to believe it, "You must be playing some trick!"
"Two adults, the testing array is right here. You can tell at a glance whether it's a trick or not." Ling Wuwang said, "The rules of the Taoist Academy are that those who pass the spiritual root test can apply for the job as handymen. Please abide by the rules."
At this moment, there was a rush of footsteps in the distance, and a disciple ran over panting, "Brother Zhao, Brother Sun, hurry up! The supervisor Wang Kun is here. If he sees you dawdling here, he will definitely be angry!"
Zhao Lei and Sun Hao's expressions changed. Wang Kun was the overseer of the outer sect's handyman camp. He was in the late stages of Qi refining and was mean. If he offended him, there would be no good consequences.
